name: Wanderer
short_desc: Self-hosted trail catalogue with GPX upload, route planning, ActivityPub federation
author: open-wanderer
description: Wanderer is an open-source, self-hosted trail database for organizing, planning, and sharing GPS tracks. Features: GPX/KML/FIT upload, full-text & map-based search, Valhalla routing for route planning, elevation profiles, summit logs, lists, photo galleries, waypoints, ActivityPub federation (follow explorers across instances), mobile apps for iOS/Android, plugin system (Strava, Komoot, Hammerhead integrations as WASM plugins). Built with SvelteKit + PocketBase + Meilisearch.
